notes.title: Version 0.5.6
notes.notes: [h1]Version 0.5.6 is now LIVE[/h1][p][/p][h1]✨ What’s new?[/h1][p][/p][h2]Localization[/h2][p]New language support![/p][list][*][p][b]Japanese[/b] - with new font that supports a greater amount of characters![/p][/*][/list][h2]Exploration[/h2][list][*][p]There is now art for the 1000th room.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Rebirth[/h2][list][*][p]New Skill that keeps Materials unlocked after rebirth.[/p][list][*][p]Price: [b]500 Hemalith[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Inventory[/h2][list][*][p]Now has a piece of paper..?[/p][/*][/list][h2]Accessibility[/h2][list][*][p]Alternative non-pixel font option in settings.[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][p]A bunch of new cursors, courtesy of Monster Lover in the discord![/p][list][*][p]New material tools icons when collecting materials that upgrade with click prestige level![/p][/*][*][p]New backpack icon while picking up an item.[/p][/*][*][p]New Lock icon while hovering over locked door.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]New Convention Build Type for convention use.[/p][/*][*][p]Migrated to Godot 4.5[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]⚙️ Changes[/h1][h2]Player[/h2][list][*][p]Health added on new levels lowered by approx 70%, but made the multiplier for each level’s hp reward 10% bigger.[/p][list][*][p]This should drastically reduce the insane amounts of HP the player gets, but grant a bit more HP later on.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated Player’s armor to have more shading in the hud.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Materials[/h2][p]Materials were a little bit too quick to unlock so I’m raising their base prices. I’m also increasing the prices of rock’s and iron’s materials upgrades. Currently you usually have a good chunk of meat when unlocking new materials which make their storage upgrades trivial to get. Hoping to make them a little slower to unlock with these changes.[/p][list][*][p]Rock and Iron unlock price: [b]10k[/b] → [b]150k[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Base meat storage prices for Rock and Iron are increased.[/p][list][*][p]Rock: [b]x100[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Iron: [b]x10k[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The onboarding’s trigger’s requirement to open the equipment room has been lowered from [b]20[/b] to [b]10[/b]. This should prevent situations where people don’t hit that cap and think they’re stuck or something is wrong with the game.[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]You can now click to skip room description text animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dark background to Combat’s boons to have better contrast.[/p][/*][*][p]Better, and more consistent UI sounds/cursors being used in more places.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill tree nodes now move around according to your mouse movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill tree nodes now hide hemalith cost multiplier if they are maxed out.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Combat[/h2][list][*][p]Attack damage boost boon is now capped at [b]1000%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Meat gain floor exponant multiplier changed from [b]2[/b] to [b]1.9[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Now tracking kill counts on enemies to potentially make them give you material production boost down the line.[/p][/*][*][p]Familiar now has unique string when missing instead of saying “You missed!” as well.[/p][/*][*][p]New bone particles when killing an enemy instead of blood.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Equipment[/h2][h3]Sword[/h3][list][*][p]Base critical hit chance: [b]1%[/b] → [b]0.2%[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Helmet[/h3][list][*][p]Base helmet attack speed : [b]3.00s[/b] → [b]1.5s[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pretty big buff to base attack speed, since we’re going to need to boost damage a lot late game because of the minimum time between attacks being slower, I’m making a little more faster at its base so it’s easier to upgrade without sacrificing too much damage. We’ll see how this plays out.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Minimum s/attacks : [b]0.01s[/b] → [b]0.1s[/b][/p][list][*][p]This is a pretty big nerf to attack speed, we’ll see how it plays out throughout a full run of the game, but this should make late game a little harder. Might bring it back down a bit if it makes progression too slow/tedious.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Item Slot Price Exponent: [b]100[/b] → [b]1000[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Chestplate[/h3][list][*][p]Defense base modifier: [b]0.3%[/b] → [b]0.2%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Base Reflection Chance: [b]1%[/b] → [b]0.2%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Base Damage Reflection Percentage: [b]1%[/b] → [b]0.2%[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Leggings[/h3][list][*][p]Minimum healing in camp is now floored at leggings’s regen stat, this way you won’t heal slower at lower health in camp.[/p][/*][*][p]Base Vampire Hit Percentage: [b]0.1%[/b] → [b]0.025%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Base Vampire of Damage Dealt: [b]0.1%[/b] → [b]0.025%[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Boots[/h3][list][*][p]Evasion base modifier: [b]0.3%[/b] → [b]0.2%[/b][/p][list][*][p]Having bumped these from [b]0.1%[/b] to [b]0.3%[/b] last patch, this made them very strong very quickly, almost cutting the time required to beat the game in half, lowering them here to hopefully make it still affordable but not too OP.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Base Opportunity Attack Chance: [b]1%[/b] → [b]0.2%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Base Opportunity Attack Damage Percentage: [b]1%[/b] → [b]0.2%[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Combat[/h2][h3]Experience Gain[/h3][list][*][p]Level exponent changed from [b]base_exp_value * current_depth^2 [/b]to[b] base_exp_value * current_depth^1.75[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Sprites[/h3][list][*][p]Mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Crow[/p][/*][*][p]Mummy[/p][/*][*][p]Sludge[/p][/*][*][p]Cyclops[/p][/*][/list][h3]Crow[/h3][list][*][p]Now stops spawning at level 400.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Skeleton[/h3][list][*][p]Now stops spawning at floor 600.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugbrute[/h3][list][*][p]Now stops spawning at floor 800.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Familiars[/h2][list][*][p]Lowered price of all familiars.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Mummy[/h3][list][*][p]Base Health: 1.6B → 1.5B[/p][/*][/list][h3]Skeleton Leader[/h3][list][*][p]Base Health: 4B → 3B[/p][/*][/list][h3]Undead Rogue[/h3][list][*][p]Base Health: 10B → 5B[/p][/*][/list][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Changed some verbiage for consistency and clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Made cursor change behavior better in skill tree.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now go back to camp by hovering and clicking at the bottom of the grate room.[/p][/*][*][p]Change the inventory to be persistent data rather than temp.[/p][list][*][p][b]Note[/b]: this will reset the key that’s on the barrels from your inventory if you have a save file with it used/owned in it, I’m making this change to prevent having to re-drop every item every run, this should make it not as tedious to get new puzzle items in the long run.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Now prebaking shaders.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Game window’s now get’s centered while changing resolutions/at launch/setting to windowed from fullscreen. This should prevent rare cases where windows put the window in the corner making the dragging bar inaccessible.[/p][/*][*][p]Warning for needing to go through rebirth before you can spend Hemalith no longer gets spammed when entering skill tree for the first time.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills no longer remain white after resetting skill tree spend.[/p][/*][*][p]God no longer invites you to spend your hemalith even though you haven't seen the hole if you haven't died.[/p][/*][*][p]God no longer hints at you to rebirth at floor 10 if you haven’t met him before.[/p][/*][*][p]Made Mouse familiar stats visible without having to repurchase it since you already owned it.[/p][/*][*][p]Made it so the blood from your familiar no longer eats mouse input from the impale station.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented consumables from being used outside of combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Made shop items check the max storage before calculating if its affordable to prevent flickering.[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped the material’s unlock icons from flashing if it was not affordable anymore after being affordable.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a check to see if Steam was running before trying to change the Rich Presence Tokens.[/p][/*][*][p]Made material upgrade buttons check for material cap before enabling themselves to prevent flashing.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented cursor from being turned into an eye during rebirth if you have pause menu opened.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed button text in combat from overflowing while on higher text size in certain languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill is now correctly shown as available to be purchased if you have the exact amount of Hemalith as its cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Material switcher button not staying held down when switching materials by clicking on them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Skill Tree descriptions styling not updating when maxing out until they’re hovered over again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Enemy Attack Timer trying to cap itself even after leaving the dungeon causing errors.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.5
notes.notes: [p]I finally took the time to play through the main gameplay loop on my own, something I haven’t actively done since the start of dev, this helped me pinpoint a few QOL things, bugfixes and changes to progression that should hopefully make for a better experience.[/p][p][/p][h1]✨ What’s new?[/h1][p][/p][h2]Combat[/h2][list][*][p]New combat backgrounds, that switch more often. 7 total backgrounds, with 3 reserved for the end of the dungeon, while the other 4 change back and forth.[/p][/*][*][p]End of run screen now shows a progress bar to show you how far you’ve made it in the dungeon.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Prestige[/h2][list][*][p]New animation while checking out prestige[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]⚙️ Changes[/h1][p][/p][h2]Progression[/h2][list][*][p]Grate room and backroom now stay unlocked when prestiging.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Combat[/h2][list][*][p]Combat now gives you your attack speed straightaway instead of waiting a second.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the exit to camp button on boon screen take a second before becoming available to prevent misclick from manual attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Now has a small animation going into the dungeon.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Familiars[/h2][list][*][p]All familiar base health got x10’d[/p][list][*][p]Especially after upping their price in last update, they feel a little too disposable and die super easily. I’m hoping this makes them last a bit longer in combat.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Equipment[/h2][list][*][p]Chestplate defense base modifier: 0.1% → 0.3%[/p][/*][*][p]Boots evasion base modifier: 0.1% → 0.3%[/p][list][*][p]Boosting these two since throughout my playthrough I could barely get them maxed out before beating the game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Leggings Rock and Iron upgrades base modifiers 1% → 0.1%[/p][list][*][p]Lowering these since leggings get 10x boost from prestige and that makes them wayyy too easy to max out mid-late game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Materials[/h2][list][*][p]Brute upgrade base price 250k → 50k[/p][/*][*][p]Golem upgrade base price 2.5M → 250k[/p][list][*][p]I noticed that these upgrades were super expensive and I never really got around to using them much, lowering to make them more accessible and increase overall Material gain.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Click value for each material on the GUI is now formatted.[/p][/*][*][p]Boot’s evasion % while boosted by a boon is now rounded to 2 decimals instead of 3+[/p][/*][*][p]\[DEMO] Now displays a message mentionning that progress is carried over to the full game.[/p][/*][*][p]\[DEMO] Now displays an “Add to wishlist” button in the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Change string of base material storage skill tree upgrade to mention multiplying by 10.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Skill Tree[/h2][list][*][p]Skill nodes are now white when available to be purchased in the skill tree order.[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor now shows an open hand on available skills.[/p][/*][*][p]New eye cursor for preview mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking while in preview mode now warns that you cannot spend in preview mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Items descriptions now are green if they are purchasable even while in preview mode.[/p][/*][*][p]God now warns you if you haven’t spent anything in prestige.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Localization[/h2][list][*][p]Updated Localization[/p][/*][/list][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Removed some combat prints in console to prevent spamming logs.[/p][/*][*][p]Made it so add to wishlist buttons call the Steam API to open the link this way users are signed in through the steam overlay to make it easier to wishlist.[/p][/*][*][p]Grate room color palette change.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Boss’s Iridescent Animation Player child nodes now correctly get freed instead of piling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies’ time before next attack now cap to their instead of carrying over their old time left which may exceed the current enemy’s attack speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Setting player is picking boon bool back to false on death in a weird edge case where it would prevent player healing after dying while picking a boon?[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing “)” to maxed out skill node modifier[/p][/*][*][p]Helmet mini-prestige no longer requires next level material cost before letting you click on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a check to see if the cursor sprite you’re trying to change to is different from the current one, if it isn’t skip changing it. This fixes a flickering cursor issue in the skill tree.[/p][/*][*][p]“Bring me a crow’s beak” string no longer shows up before first god dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Button to see into prestige now requires you to have interacted with god first.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some equipment effects displays in equipement/store round up less.[/p][/*][*][p]Discord and steam buttons on end of demo screen not opening links.[/p][/*][*][p]Max skill level outline not being reset on reset[/p][/*][*][p]God doesn’t tell you to use your hemalith if you haven’t died yet (and thus haven’t unlocked god).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.4
notes.notes: [h1]✨ What’s new?[/h1][list][*][p]New tiered pixel art Knight cursors - Thanks to Monster Lover in the discord for making them![/p][list][*][p]Copper from 0 → 75[/p][/*][*][p]Silver from 75 → 150[/p][/*][*][p]Gold from 150 → infinite[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Combat[/h2][list][*][p]Added an exit combat button on the boons picking page, this way if you forgot to set the auto-exit, you may exit at the boon picking stage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]⚙️ Changes[/h1][p][/p][h2]Familiars[/h2][p]Familiars prices have been a little on the lower side, letting you get super powerful familiars early letting you move a lot faster than you should be able to, I’m increasing prices of some of them, to hopefully make it more like they were supposed to be at the start. The original intent was to have each familiar worth it/affordable at each 100 floor. Let me know how they feel now, if they’re now underpowered for what they cost, could boost some stats later on.[/p][p][/p][h3]Skeleton[/h3][p]Cost: [b]25k[/b] → [b]10M[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Spider[/h3][p]Cost: [b]500k[/b] → [b]500M[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Stingbat[/h3][p]Cost: [b]5M[/b] → [b]1.25B[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Amalgam[/h3][p]Cost: [b]15M[/b] → [b]10B[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Dwarf[/h3][p]Cost: [b]50M[/b] → [b]50B[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Cyclops[/h3][p]Cost: [b]100M[/b] → [b]250B[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Mummy[/h3][p]Cost: [b]200M[/b] → [b]500B[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Skeleton Leader[/h3][p]Cost: [b]500M[/b] → [b]750B[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Undead Rogue[/h3][p]Cost: [b]5B[/b] → [b]1T[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Materials[/h2][list][*][p]Changed added percentage chance of spawning a sparkle from +0.1% on click to +0.05% to make it appear a little bit less often, but it’s still very common.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the “New material is unlockable” move a bit to be more noticeable[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Combat’s door icon now has a handle to be a little bit more clear about what it is.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the backroom’s door to be grey instead of the same color as the background, should help it make it more visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed verbiage in prestige buttons from “Commit to rebirth” to “Spend Hemalith” to hopefully help clarify how the spending system works, as people have been having a hard time figuring it out.[/p][/*][*][p]Attack speed labels are now correctly rounded instead of showing long numbers.[/p][/*][*][p]Pick your boon buttons percentages are not correctly rounded instead of getting crazy long.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Material sparkle now only appears over the map hover section.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy manual hit / weak spot now only appears over the map hover section.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed combat restarting even if you’re picking boon after exiting pause menu[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.3
notes.notes: [h1]✨ What’s new?[/h1][list][*][p]The game now has a bunch of new cursors which change depending on context, which should make some actions clearer![/p][/*][/list][h3]Prestige[/h3][list][*][p]You now have to drop a crow’s beak in combat to prove your worth before prestiging. This will not apply if you’ve already prestiged.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Combat[/h3][list][*][p]Combat now has randomly spawning weak points spawning on the enemy that when clicked gives you an extra attack.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Materials[/h3][list][*][p]Materials now get a critical hit point that gets shown every so often, with a chance of it appearing getting greater with each click, that gets you a bonus of material you’re currently clicking (based on your click power).[/p][/*][*][p]You can now use 1,2,3 keys to switch between materials.[/p][/*][*][p]Materials now have a little pop up at the bottom telling you you may unlock them when you can![/p][/*][/list][h3]Prestige[/h3][list][*][p]Skill tree description box now styles itself depending on if it’s available to be bought or not.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]⚙️ Changes[/h1][h3]Combat[/h3][list][*][p]Boons now round up to 2 decimals instead of going to crazy long numbers[/p][/*][*][p]Item timers are now paused while picking a boon.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Misc[/h3][list][*][p]Updated Localization[/p][/*][*][p]Fade to black animation is faster by 0.8s[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Now correctly resetting boons and attack bars progress when getting kicked out from combat at the end of demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Now checking that discord is well connected before trying to refresh Rich Presence — which should fix log spamming and potential illegal memory write attempts that may lead to crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added greater null checking for Familiars to prevent trying to access values that are nulls eg if your familiar dies while its attacking and trying to find its attack damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up some animation keyframes for boss iridescence and GUI shaking, which was potentially causing errors trying to reach unnatainable keyframes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed helmet upgrade always resetting attack speed while upgrading other materials upgrades. Now checking for which material is selected before giving you the mini helmet perstige.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken Sentry config overriding user consent in last build re-export patch.[/p][/*][*][p]Leggings and sword base modifiers now correctly show how much they add on level up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boon labels and buttons showing effects affected by boon mults twice.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.2
notes.notes: [h1]⚙️ Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Now attaching Node Scene Tree to crash/error reporting for greater context.[/p][/*][*][p]Recompiled export templates for Windows for 4.4.1, was currently using 4.5.dev, should prevent potential weird behavior from version mismatch.[/p][/*][/list][h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Balance reset now correctly given instead of every time you boot.[/p][/*][*][p]Not being able to heal after beating the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped Dialogue after beating 10 floors from being shown at end of demo and fixed its pop up happening every run.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.1
notes.notes: [h1]✨ What’s new?[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Implemented Sentry for crash/error tracking.[/p][list][*][p]You will be prompted to activate them or not, it's up to you if you want to share your crash/error logs with me, but if you do, it would greatly help![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Settings[/h2][list][*][p]Text Speed Slider, you can now go up to 2x text animation speed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]The familiar sacrifice now has a prompt when hovering over it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]⚙️ Changes[/h1][p][/p][h2]Equipment[/h2][p][/p][h3]Helmet - Boon Multiplier[/h3][p]This upgrade was wayyyyy too powerful for how much your prestige boosts your helmet, I’m lowering its base modifier drastically, we’ll see how it feels.[/p][list][*][p]Base modifier: [b]5%[/b] → [b]0.25%[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Balance pile of materials camp’s outline on hover is now smaller.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Evasion’s upgrade display was rounding too many decimals causing the UI to show +0.00%. This is now fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Consumables UI not being reset on prestige and creating un-depletable consumables.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.0
notes.notes: [p]I’ve overhauled the equipment system with this update. You will receive a refund for materials you’ve spent at your camp so you can reallocate your resources accordingly.[/p][p][/p][h1]✨ What’s new?[/h1][list][*][p]The game now hints at you to prestige if you’ve reached level 10 without having prestiged once.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sacrifice your familiar for some meat.[/p][/*][*][p]There are now 5 different items for you to purchase, however, your item slot cap is by default 1, and you may upgrade it up to 3, via your helmet iron upgrades.[/p][list][*][p]Healing Potion - Heals for 20% of max health.[/p][/*][*][p]Spiky Bone - Damage Boost for 30 secs[/p][/*][*][p]Weird Fruit - Healing Boost for 30 secs[/p][/*][*][p]Moldy Mushroom - Defense Boost for 30 secs[/p][/*][*][p]Skull Amulet - Instantly Kill current enemy.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Combat[/h2][list][*][p]Added a progress bar for enemy attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled loading while in combat.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Materials[/h2][p]Materials now upgrade individual skills for equipment, giving them a unique purpose.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583362/eb398f57480ddd429ff309ef7420a6d2210a8814.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Sword[/p][list][*][p]Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Crit Chance[/p][/*][*][p]Crit Multiplier[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Helmet[/p][list][*][p]Attack speed[/p][/*][*][p]Boon % effectiveness[/p][/*][*][p]Item slots[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Chestplate[/p][list][*][p]Defense[/p][/*][*][p]Reflect Chance[/p][/*][*][p]Reflect percentage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Leggings[/p][list][*][p]Healing[/p][/*][*][p]Chance of vampire[/p][/*][*][p]Vampire % of damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Boots[/p][list][*][p]Evasion[/p][/*][*][p]Opportunity Attack Chance[/p][/*][*][p]Attack damage (% of sword)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]⚙️ Changes[/h1][p][/p][h2]Combat[/h2][list][*][p]Removed Vampire % boon as it now is an upgradable stat.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Crow[/h3][p]Evasion: [b]35%[/b] → [b]20%[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Save and Load buttons now have toasts that indicate that they’re saving/loading the game.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed Bosses having bbcode names in Discord Rich Presence[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game saving not saving number of total runs.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.4.5
notes.notes:
[h1]✨ What’s new?[/h1]

I’ve heard from quite a few people that they’d like to have shortcuts to quickly change between locations, you now can use the num keys (rebindable) to change between locations.

- You can now use num keys to switch to specific locations on the map while the map is open.
- Backroom location on the map.

[h2]Combat[/h2]

- Better feedback for getting hit.
---- Player getting hit SFX
---- Flashes for healing + damage taken
- Familiar now has a scratch animation instead of the basic swipe.

[h1]⚙️ Changes[/h1]

I’ve heard quite a bit that progression feels slow and that mat gain should be easier, and that clicking should be more rewarding. With this balance patch, I’m hoping to make progression feel more rewarding and promote investing in individual upgrades.

[h2]Materials[/h2]

- Now adds 1 of the effect’s base value extra every 10 upgrades:
---- eg: Click 0.2 base. → on 10 upgrades bought → Click Upgrade = 0.2 + 0.2 = 0.4
---- [b]base effect + (floor(owned/10) * base effect)[/b]
- Upgrade buttons now show the full effect they’re adding - including multipliers from material level and prestige skills! Finally!
- Changed the name of some upgrades to make it reflect monsters actually in the dungeon instead of random names that were there from the beginning of dev that didn’t really make sense.

[h3]Click upgrade[/h3]

- Base effect: [b]0.1/c → 0.2/c[/b]

[h2]Prestige[/h2]

- Comitting to prestige now has a different color panel. Which should make differenciating between preview and prestige mode clearer.
- When you have spent hemalith on certain skills, they now show up more clearly in yellow.

[h2]Equipment[/h2]

- Leggings regen’s effect is now [b](1.4^leggings_level)*mults[/b] which should make it much more effective.
- Health Potion’s price calculation changed : [b]10% of max health[/b] → [b]((1.00205^level) + (level/2))[/b]
---- This should make the potion much more affordable at first, making it exponentially expensive as you gain more levels.

[h2]Localization[/h2]

- Updated Strings

[h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed not being able to heal after giving up the fight while picking a boon.
- Panel styling for unaffordable potion
- Fixed stutter while opening the settings menu.

[h1]🔮 What’s next?[/h1]

I intend on changing how the different materials work. As it currently stands, each material is kind of acting as another wood, simply used to fulfill the increasing cost of equipment. In the future, I’d like to make it useful for different stat upgrades: eg: Sword: Wood → Damage, Rock → Crit Chance, Iron → Crit Mult.

Other things I want to add:

- A way to sacrifice your familiar.
- A minigame that gives you some extra material once in a while, kinda like golden cookies in cookie clicker.
- Maybe new potions? Temporary speed boost, damage boost, defense boost?

And of course, all the puzzles and things to do in the dungeon in the full game. Keep the feedback coming! Thanks for trying out Horripilant!

notes.title: Version 0.3.0 [Beta Playtesting]
notes.notes:
Once again a polish update adding a lot of QOL stuff. Next up with 0.4.0 is a big rebalancing of general progression, keep an eye out for that. Then with 0.5.0 I want to implement the general puzzles and progression of the game. Before this I’ll work on a devlog to push the store page out, go wishlist the game!

[h2]✨ What’s new?[/h2]

- Game now has music!
- Combat now displays how far along you are on a certain floor.
- Main Menu rework!
    - You can now have 3 different save files.
- New SFX!
    - When opening/closing map.
    - Fire crackle in camp.
    - Gulp while using a potion.
    - Reverb is now applied across the game. - Let me know your thoughts if it’s too much or not!

    - New V-SYNC setting. (Doesn’t uncap FPS, kind of useless for this game but it’s there in case it creates any issues.)
    - New FPS cap setting.
